text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I made it through the Takarazuka<n>Kinen... and Opera
O and Doto were<n>both more precious than ever!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the two declare their<n>rivalry. A feeling
I can't describe<n>wells up within me—but I can't tell
if<n>the heat comes from this fateful<n>moment or
something... else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way to find out,<n>though. By
running more races! Stay<n>tuned next episode for the
Japan Dirt<n>Derby!
